how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-hillsbrad-foothills-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:494:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.
rows.quest:494:details:1: I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. My mission is one of reconnaissance. It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:
rows.quest:494:details:2: B"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."
rows.quest:494:details:3: Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. Now, hurry! Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
rows.quest:494:completion:0: The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?
rows.quest:494:completion:1: Superb news! Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. We can carry out our plan of destruction now. Varimathras will be pleased.
rows.quest:496:obj:0: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:496:details:0: Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:496:details:1: The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.
rows.quest:496:details:2: If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, ⟦E2⟧. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:496:progress:0: I see you are back. I hope you were able to gather the agents I need. Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
rows.quest:496:completion:0: These specimens are perfect. Well, ⟦3⟧, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. Your efforts are appreciated.
rows.quest:498:obj:0: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
rows.quest:498:details:0: Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:498:details:1: We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.
rows.quest:498:details:2: Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
rows.quest:498:progress:0: You must make haste, ⟦4⟧. I shudder to think what the humans might be doing to Drull and Tog'thar.
rows.quest:498:completion:0: So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!
rows.quest:498:completion:1: It would seem that they have taken ⟦E4⟧, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...
rows.quest:498:completion:2: When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:499:details:0: It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:499:details:1: There we go! Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.
rows.quest:499:details:2: Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:499:details:3: Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
rows.quest:549:obj:0: Kill 10 ⟦E3⟧ Rogues and 10 ⟦E3⟧ ⟦E7⟧. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.
rows.quest:549:details:0: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the ⟦E3⟧ are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:549:details:1: BA handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
rows.quest:549:progress:0: Do you have nothing better to do than stand here before me, ⟦6⟧? As High Executor, I have more pressing matters than to stare at your rotting visage.
rows.quest:549:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦7⟧. At this rate, the ⟦E3⟧ pest will be rid from the land in no time.
rows.quest:501:obj:0: Bring 10 vials of ⟦E8⟧ to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:501:details:0: Oh, ⟦8⟧. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk. I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all. I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.
rows.quest:501:details:1: As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls. Help me, would you? My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion. Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
rows.quest:501:progress:0: I remember you, ⟦9⟧. You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir. I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
rows.quest:502:details:0: Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!
rows.quest:502:details:1: Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! What I have created with this blood, I like to call an ⟦E9⟧. If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. But what we need is a test.
rows.quest:502:details:2: Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
rows.quest:502:completion:0: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
rows.quest:527:obj:0: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:527:details:0: Stand at attention while addressing me, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:527:details:1: I am under direct command of Varimathras. We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.
rows.quest:527:details:2: Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack. Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.
rows.quest:527:details:3: ⟦E1⟧ west. ⟦E10⟧ the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields. Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
rows.quest:527:progress:0: As High Executor of Tarren Mill, under the direct command of Varimathras and the Dark Lady, you are subject to follow my command.⟦12⟧⟦13⟧Perhaps you take this war with the ⟦E11⟧ lightly? If such is the case I should behead you right here and now. Otherwise, travel west to the town of Hillsbrad and wage ⟦E12⟧ against the humans, as ordered.⟦14⟧⟦15⟧Dismissed.
rows.quest:527:completion:0: At ease, ⟦16⟧. I see you have returned from ⟦E12⟧. My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
rows.quest:528:obj:0: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:528:details:0: Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. Most excellent.
rows.quest:528:details:1: Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.
rows.quest:528:details:2: Prove them wrong, ⟦17⟧. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.
rows.quest:528:progress:0: You have your orders, ⟦18⟧. Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.
rows.quest:528:completion:0: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. The ⟦E12⟧ goes well.
rows.quest:546:obj:0: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad ⟦E13⟧ Skulls.
rows.quest:546:details:0: I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad. So jealous I am. . .
rows.quest:546:details:1: While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:546:details:2: Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself? You see I am collecting human skulls. And you will be fighting humans for quite some time. Over the course of your long ⟦E12⟧, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
rows.quest:546:progress:0: So the lucky ⟦19⟧ returns? How many humans have you slaughtered today? Hundreds I do hope!⟦20⟧⟦21⟧Have you any skulls for me?
rows.quest:546:completion:0: Precious skulls! So beautiful! I owe you as promised, ⟦22⟧!
rows.quest:529:obj:0: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.
rows.quest:529:obj:1: Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:529:details:0: The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected ⟦E14⟧. The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith. We need to shut down all supply lines.
rows.quest:529:details:1: Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan. Slay his apprentices as well. While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile. The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:529:progress:0: Were you able to carry out your orders, ⟦23⟧? Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants? And where is that iron shipment?
rows.quest:529:completion:0: Mission accomplished, ⟦24⟧. And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
rows.quest:532:obj:0: Kill Magistrate Burnside and 4 Hillsbrad Councilmen. Destroy the Hillsbrad Proclamation. Steal the ⟦E16⟧. Report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill afterwards.
rows.quest:532:details:0: The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall. We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.
rows.quest:532:details:1: Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting. We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council. Destroy their ⟦E17⟧ political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation. And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
rows.quest:532:completion:0: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast. You have done well, ⟦25⟧.
rows.quest:509:obj:0: Bring 6 ⟦E18⟧ to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:509:details:0: Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is.
rows.quest:509:details:1: Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?
rows.quest:509:details:2: Here's the plan, ⟦26⟧: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and ⟦E15⟧. Collect for me 6 ⟦E18⟧ from the field for my next elixir.
rows.quest:509:completion:0: Ah, the horrible reek of ⟦E18⟧. At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.
rows.quest:513:obj:0: Take the ⟦E19⟧ to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:513:details:0: Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:513:details:1: First I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E20⟧ to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!
rows.quest:513:details:2: Here, take this ⟦E19⟧ and run it off to Master Faranell at once, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:513:progress:0: Can you not see I am busy, ⟦28⟧? The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us. And with the human ⟦E21⟧ pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity. This better be important!
rows.quest:513:completion:0: Apothecary Lydon sent you? Ah, why didn't you say so!
rows.quest:513:completion:1: Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.
rows.quest:513:completion:2: The good chap sends ⟦E19⟧! I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now. And I like the way he thinks. The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
rows.quest:539:obj:0: Kill ⟦E22⟧ Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:539:details:0: The ⟦E16⟧ indicates that the Azureload Mine is under ⟦E11⟧ control. Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the ⟦E11⟧ armories.
rows.quest:539:details:1: Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the ⟦E11⟧ still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.
rows.quest:539:details:2: The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad. Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds. Kill his miners as well. That should send a clear message to the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:539:progress:0: You were given direct orders to attack the Azureload Mine. Your reasons for loafing about Tarren Mill better be good or I will behead you for treason.
rows.quest:539:completion:0: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
rows.quest:567:obj:0: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
rows.quest:567:details:1: The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:
rows.quest:567:details:2: Clerk Horrace Whitesteed. Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.
rows.quest:567:details:3: Citizen Wilkes. Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.
rows.quest:567:details:4: Miner Hackett. Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.
rows.quest:567:details:5: Farmer Kalaba. Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:567:details:6: All of these ⟦E24⟧ are hiding and will be hard to find. A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
rows.quest:567:completion:0: You are quite the bounty hunter, ⟦29⟧. Well done.
rows.quest:515:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E25⟧, a Strong ⟦E26⟧'s ⟦E27⟧ Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:515:details:0: A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
rows.quest:515:details:1: Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.
rows.quest:515:details:2: In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood potion, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
rows.quest:515:progress:0: So glad to see you back, ⟦30⟧. I was growing so terribly bored here. Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her. . .over and over and over again.⟦31⟧⟦32⟧How went the trip to the ⟦E20⟧? Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?
rows.quest:515:completion:0: The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! You have been such a great help, ⟦33⟧. Together we will spread death and disease to this land!
rows.quest:517:obj:0: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:517:details:0: This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.
rows.quest:517:details:1: ⟦E28⟧ down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the ⟦E29⟧, ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:517:progress:0: Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air. Makes Umpi a little nervous though.⟦35⟧⟦36⟧So were you able to get a keg from the ⟦E30⟧? I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using on it someone for another day I am going to scream.
rows.quest:517:completion:0: Finally! Now we are ready for action!
rows.quest:524:obj:0: Place the ⟦E31⟧ on the rug for the captured farmers.
rows.quest:524:details:0: Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from ⟦E32⟧ to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the ⟦E33⟧ last night. Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.
rows.quest:524:details:1: I think it's time we threw those farmers a ⟦E29⟧. Sounds like a grand ol' time!
rows.quest:524:details:2: Place this tainted keg on the rug in their room. Plagued brew for all!
rows.quest:524:progress:0: A musty smell emanates from the rug.
rows.quest:524:completion:0: You rest the tainted deg on the dusty rug.
rows.quest:536:obj:0: Kill 10 Torn Fin Tidehunters and 10 Torn Fin Oracles for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:536:details:0: Transferred from the ⟦E32⟧ city guard to ⟦E15⟧, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.
rows.quest:536:details:1: Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha!
rows.quest:536:details:2: I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.
rows.quest:536:progress:0: Another ale, please, the last one just seemed to have disappeared!⟦37⟧⟦38⟧Light, how much longer am I going to be stuck out here?⟦39⟧⟦40⟧Oh, it's you, ⟦41⟧. Have you killed those murlocs yet?
rows.quest:536:completion:0: I hope this will be enough to convince Redpath that I've--ha!--been carrying out his orders and ridding ⟦E15⟧ of the terrible and horrible menace of the dreaded murlocs! For there could be no greater evil than the ravages of overgrown fish!
rows.quest:541:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:541:details:0: ⟦E30⟧ aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts.
rows.quest:541:details:1: We shall test the strength of the so-called ⟦E11⟧. We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.
rows.quest:541:details:2: They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. The final mission of this ⟦E12⟧ is to lay siege on Dun Garok, ⟦42⟧. Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
rows.quest:541:progress:0: Dun Garok proves to be too much of an obstacle for you, ⟦43⟧? And here I thought you had established yourself valiantly in Hillsbrad.⟦44⟧⟦45⟧If you're not up to handle the mission assigned to you, I will find another who can produce better results. As for you, well, I am sure the Dark Lady could always use more grave diggers back in ⟦E34⟧.
rows.quest:541:completion:0: Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.
rows.quest:547:obj:0: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:547:details:0: High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance. I had set up camp just out of sight. But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.
rows.quest:547:details:1: When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.
rows.quest:547:details:2: Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it. I need my sword! If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful. So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
rows.quest:547:progress:0: Were you able to retrieve my sword, ⟦46⟧? High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
rows.quest:547:completion:1: Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand. Many thanks to you!
rows.quest:555:obj:0: Bring 10 pieces of ⟦E35⟧ and some ⟦E36⟧ to Chef Jessen in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:555:details:0: If there's one thing you'll learn about ⟦E15⟧ it's that we have some of the best cuisine north of ⟦E32⟧!
rows.quest:555:details:1: Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks to travel from as far as Darkshire just to enjoy a bowl. Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head up past ⟦E37⟧ to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt Snapjaws but it's just too dangerous now. If you bring me some ⟦E35⟧ from the Snapjaws up north and ⟦E36⟧, I'll whip some up!
rows.quest:555:progress:0: Any luck finding the ingredients? I'll tell you, this territory isn't the peaceful place it once was. Ah, if only this unrest never occurred...
rows.quest:555:completion:0: Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's ⟦E38⟧ is served once again!
rows.quest:550:details:0: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the ⟦E40⟧, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics ⟦E41⟧ for the high command to recognize.
rows.quest:550:details:1: Take this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the ⟦E20⟧. Go with pride, ⟦47⟧.
rows.quest:550:progress:0: What brings a ⟦48⟧ all the way to the ⟦E20⟧ from the battlefield?
rows.quest:550:completion:0: So you are the infamous ⟦49⟧ who struck such a decisive blow against the ⟦E11⟧ forces in the ⟦E42⟧? Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:550:completion:1: You have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:550:completion:2: While our primary ⟦E21⟧ is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our ⟦E12⟧ plans. You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
rows.quest:559:obj:0: Collect 10 Murloc Heads from the murlocs on the Western Strand for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:559:details:0: Would you believe it, ⟦50⟧? Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed--oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it. Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.
rows.quest:559:progress:0: Did you get those heads for me, ⟦51⟧?
rows.quest:559:completion:0: Oh for the Love of the Light... they're dripping on the ground.
rows.quest:559:completion:1: Can't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around... Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in ⟦E15⟧, that means you aren't eating much.
rows.quest:560:obj:0: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:560:details:0: You know, ⟦52⟧, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
rows.quest:560:progress:0: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of ⟦E15⟧?
rows.quest:560:completion:1: If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. ⟦E15⟧ needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
rows.quest:561:obj:0: Speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:561:details:0: Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand. When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.
rows.quest:561:completion:0: The naga, eh? Redpath must have just received the same information as me... Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil. Let me explain.
rows.quest:562:obj:0: Kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:562:details:0: My former mentor in the ⟦E32⟧ city guard sent a message to me that ⟦E11⟧ High Command is becoming concerned with the ⟦E21⟧ posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.
rows.quest:562:details:1: There's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, ⟦53⟧. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, ⟦54⟧!
rows.quest:562:progress:0: I've a letter ready to go to Major Samuelson in ⟦E32⟧. All I need are the results.
rows.quest:562:completion:0: With the naga put down in ⟦E15⟧, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see ⟦E32⟧ again... get away from this Light-forsaken port.
rows.quest:563:obj:0: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in ⟦E32⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:563:details:0: It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in ⟦E32⟧. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.
rows.quest:563:progress:0: Greetings, citizen. May the ⟦E32⟧ city guard be of assistance?
rows.quest:563:completion:0: What's this? Ah... so my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in ⟦E15⟧. Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.
rows.quest:676:obj:0: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the ⟦E43⟧ outpost in ⟦E44⟧.
rows.quest:676:details:0: Weaklings... all of them. You, ⟦55⟧, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?
rows.quest:676:details:1: The ⟦E43⟧ outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.
rows.quest:676:details:2: But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in ⟦E43⟧.
rows.quest:676:progress:0: I have not the time to sharpen my axe, let alone leave the outpost to slay those beasts that would try and slay my kin.⟦56⟧⟦57⟧You do not seem to have the experience of a grunt let alone a full-fledged warrior, what do you want, ⟦58⟧?
rows.quest:676:completion:0: So, you think you're strong enough to help ⟦E43⟧? So be it.
rows.quest:676:completion:1: Tallow either sent you to that ogre mound in the hopes that you would kill yourself or he thinks you're strong enough to aid us. Either way, you're here now and I am in need of more soldiers in our fight against the constant attacks.
rows.quest:676:completion:2: If you plan on staying in ⟦E43⟧ then get some rest, and come speak to me again when you're ready. There's no shortage of fighting to be had.
